description: Change a status page incident's title without telling anyone: nothing is sent to subscribers. To change its status or add a message use post_status_page_update. Requires a key with the write scope. Returns the incident. Example: {"page_id": "<id from list_status_pages>", "incident_id": "<id from list_status_page_incidents>", "title": "API errors in eu-central"}

incident_id.description: The status page incident's uuid from list_status_page_incidents (not from list_incidents). An unknown id is a 404.

page_id.description: The status page's uuid from list_status_pages. An id that is not a status page of this organization is a 404.

name: update_status_page_incident

status.description: Known values: INVESTIGATING, IDENTIFIED, MONITORING, RESOLVED.
